prompt:
Write a client review left on a freelance platform for Tobias Reyne after this project.

Project facts (the only truth you may use):
title: Monthly statement PDF generator
client: Alder Property Group
client_industry: real estate
start: 2022-07
end: 2022-09
engagement: fixed
stack:
- Node.js
- BullMQ
- Redis
- Puppeteer
- AWS S3
implied_skills:
- background jobs
- PDF generation
built: A queue that renders owner statements to PDF overnight and stores them in S3
  instead of building them on request.
metrics:
- 12k statements a month
- request timeouts went from daily to none

The review is from: Alder Property Group
Rating: 5.0 out of 5

Requirements:
- 2 to 5 sentences in the voice of a busy client, not a marketer.
- Focus mostly on how they handled feedback; do not just repeat the project summary.
- If the rating is below 4.5, include one honest complaint (communication, delays or scope).
- Only mention results that appear in the facts. Never use: "background jobs", "PDF generation".
text: Tobias was easy to work with and took feedback well throughout the project. When we asked for changes, he responded quickly, adjusted the approach without fuss, and kept things moving. The result was solid: our statements now generate overnight and the request timeouts we were seeing daily went away. Would work with him again.
